_comment: Schema facts captured READ-ONLY from IgniteHeX production. TypeScript types carry no DEFAULT, CHECK or precise-type information, so gen-recovered-schema.mjs reads them from here instead of inferring them. Regenerate with SBP=<token> REF=<ref> node scripts/pull-schema-facts.mjs. Do not hand-edit.

_source.server_version: PostgreSQL 17.6 on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 13.2.0, 64-bit

guardian_invitations.name: invitation_target
guardian_invitations.def: CHECK (((invited_email IS NOT NULL) OR (invited_str_domain IS NOT NULL)))

str_domains.name: str_domains_domain_name_format
str_domains.def: CHECK (((domain_name IS NOT NULL) AND (length(domain_name) >= 3) AND (length(domain_name) <= 63)))
